opening.argument: The speaker promotes buying StrongBlock nodes as a route to passive income while requiring a recurring $15 monthly maintenance fee for each node. He presents a first-person account of spending $24,000 on four nodes, then claims, "I've made $2,000 back in 10 days," treating that return favorably. He further projects recovering the remaining expenditure in "about 90 more days" before receiving what he calls "free passive income." These payment-to-return claims form a promotional testimonial for paid nodes and anticipated returns.

citations.quote: Exactly 10 days ago I spent $24,000 on 4 nodes on the StrongBlock network
Now each node you buy will make you some passive income, you just have to pay a monthly maintenance fee of $15 per node
And so far I've made $2,000 back in 10 days, which is pretty good.
That means it'll take me about 90 more days to make all my money back And then it's just free passive income.
